corporateActionLog.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A
corporateActionLog.headline: Announced separation of a business unit
corporateActionLog.detail: A distribution ratio and the basis allocation between the parent and the new entity have not been published. Nothing is applied to the position until the distribution date.

corporateActionLog.name: Nasdaq 100 Covered Call
corporateActionLog.headline: Fund reorganisation, shares exchanged 1-for-1
corporateActionLog.detail: The fund was reorganised into a new trust. Holdings were exchanged one for one and the original cost basis carried over, so nothing changed on the position.

corporateActionLog.name: Silver Covered Call ETN
corporateActionLog.headline: Ticker changed from CSLS to SLVO
corporateActionLog.detail: Listing symbol only. Shares, cost basis and the distribution schedule all carried over unchanged.

corporateActionLog.name: Gold Covered Call ETN
corporateActionLog.headline: Year-end return of capital, $5.57 a share
corporateActionLog.detail: The issuer classified part of the year’s distributions as a return of capital. It is not taxed as income — it reduces the cost basis instead, so the eventual capital gain is larger.

corporateActionLog.name: Silver Covered Call ETN
corporateActionLog.headline: Year-end return of capital, $10.02 a share
corporateActionLog.detail: Same treatment as the gold note: basis reduced, nothing taxed as income this year.

corporateActionLog.name: PepsiCo, Inc.
corporateActionLog.headline: Special cash dividend of $0.62 a share
corporateActionLog.detail: Paid in cash alongside the regular quarterly distribution. No effect on shares or cost basis; the amount is inside the dividends already recorded for this holding.

corporateActionLog.name: Gold Covered Call ETN
corporateActionLog.headline: 1-for-4 reverse split
corporateActionLog.detail: The issuer consolidated four notes into one to lift the quoted price. Share count fell to a quarter, basis per share rose four-fold, total basis unchanged.

corporateActionLog.name: NVIDIA Corporation
corporateActionLog.headline: 4-for-1 forward stock split
corporateActionLog.detail: Each share held became four. The cost basis per share fell to a quarter of its previous level; the total basis is unchanged.
